claim: ListSnapshotProgress joins cdc_system.snapshot_progress sp with cdc_system.source_object_registry so and LEFT JOIN LATERAL on cdc_system.shadow_binding s.
flow: 1. Query cdc_system.snapshot_progress sp. 2. Join cdc_system.source_object_registry so ON so.id = sp.source_object_id. 3. LEFT JOIN LATERAL cdc_system.shadow_binding s with LIMIT 1.
evidence:

		JOIN cdc_system.source_object_registry so ON so.id = sp.source_object_id
		LEFT JOIN cdc_system.connection_registry cr ON cr.id = so.source_connection_id
		LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
			SELECT s.shadow_schema, s.shadow_table
			FROM cdc_system.shadow_binding s
			WHERE (sp.shadow_binding_id IS NOT NULL AND s.id = sp.shadow_binding_id)

			ORDER BY s.id DESC
			LIMIT 1
		) sb ON TRUE
